answer: Sybil resistance binds each agent identity to a remotely attested enclave measurement, MRENCLAVE, verified through the TEE vendor’s attestation chain. A copied key or virtual-machine image cannot produce the same trusted measurement; creating another identity requires purchasing and provisioning separate physical silicon, making mass cloning costly rather than virtual. Application labels such as nectar, echo, and whisper are irrelevant to trust unless backed by a valid attestation.
